summary: Oscilloscope and vectorscope that pass the audio through untouched: the waveform (left, right, mid, side, or left and right overlaid) over a time base synced to the song (1/16 note to 4 bars, aligned to the bar so a loop stands still) or free in time per division with an edge trigger, and a goniometer or polar vectorscope with a correlation meter. Use it to show the user a signal while it plays (a loop's waveform standing still, a synth's cycle, the stereo image); machine_readings gives its peak, RMS, correlation and trigger lock. To look at audio yourself, render and use plot (waveform, goniometer) and analyze.
use_for: Watch the waveform or stereo image of any signal without changing it.

parameters.name: Display
parameters.description: What the scope draws: the left or right channel, mid (L + R)/2, side (L − R)/2, or left and right overlaid

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: The screen's width as a note value of the song's tempo, its sweeps starting on the song's beats and bars (a bar is 4 beats), so a loop stands still; while the song stands still it runs free at the tempo. Free: Time/div and the trigger

parameters.name: Time/div
parameters.description: With Sync Free: the time per division, 10 across the screen (0.1 ms – 200 ms)

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.description: With Sync Free: each sweep starts where the first trace crosses Level going up (Rising) or down (Falling); with no crossing for two sweeps' time (at least 100 ms) it runs free until one comes. Off: sweeps follow each other

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The trigger's level, in percent of full scale (0 dBFS)

parameters.name: Holdoff
parameters.description: After a sweep, the trigger waits this long before it looks for the next crossing (0 – 500 ms)

parameters.name: Auto scale
parameters.description: On: both displays fit the signal (the scope its sweep's peak, the vectorscope its points). Off: Gain

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: With Auto scale Off: the vertical gain of both displays, in 0.5 dB steps (0 dB: full scale fills the screen)

parameters.name: Trail
parameters.description: Earlier sweeps stay behind the newest, fading over about 0.15, 0.4 or 1 s

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Holds both displays; the readings go on

parameters.name: Vector
parameters.description: Lissajous: the goniometer (mid up, side across, the left channel up-left). Polar: each sample at its angle and level, folded into the upper half (mono straight up, opposed channels along the base)

readings.description: The highest sample of either channel over the last 3 s
The RMS of both channels over the last 3 s, dB (a full-scale sine reads −3 dB, as analyze reads it)
The correlation of left and right over the last 3 s: 1 mono, 0 unrelated, −1 opposed (the analysis library's)
1 while the sweeps start on the trigger (Sync Free, Trigger Rising or Falling, and the last sweep found its crossing), else 0
